appearance_facts.location: line plot, x-axis 2005 to 2015, y-axis 0 to ~24
appearance_facts.fact: A single blue line with black circular markers descends monotonically from the top-left to the bottom-right across the plot area.
The first data point is the highest on the chart, with a label above it.
The last data point is the lowest on the chart, with a label above it.
The steepest single-year drop appears between 2009 and 2010.
The line flattens noticeably, showing smaller year-over-year decreases.
The decline resumes and steepens again toward the final point.
No point rises above the previous point; the trend is strictly downward.

uncertain: The point labels include a leading '$' symbol before the °C values (e.g., '$24.0°C'), which is inconsistent with a temperature unit; the intended numeric values are read as the digits shown.
No explicit threshold value defining 'substantial' change is provided in the policy tables or instructions, so the magnitude must be judged from the charted values alone.
The 2011 marker is present on the line but has no visible numeric label above it.
